title: Dashboard poll must not spawn CMD/PowerShell

already_implemented_before_this_stage_be.context: Stage 5ZZX finished around 07:35; this stage began after 08:04
what_existed: no ops call in either file

work: verified the existing implementation by measurement
wrote the test suite and mutation harness
found and fixed the cross-sleeve recovery defect under task 6
moved nine Stage 5ZZW tests to the new seam

attribution.note: recorded because the alternative is a report that reads as though I wrote all of it

the_regression.introduced_by: Stage 5ZZW - the backend asked the scheduler for its mode via ops.track1_status()
the_regression.why_it_mattered: a page polling every eight seconds opens a console several times a minute; Stage 5ZZX's log filters could not have helped because the noise was never in the log
the_regression.why_the_backend_already_had_the_answer: _scan_scheduler_processes() enumerates with psutil, keeps each scheduler's command line, and sits behind a 60s TTL with a background refresh; its docstring says 'never call this on a request path'

measurement_that_had_to_be_redone.first_probe: reported zero subprocess calls from every endpoint
measurement_that_had_to_be_redone.why_suspicious: a zero that convenient is a reason to check the instrument
measurement_that_had_to_be_redone.self_check: a deliberate subprocess.run proved the spy was live; calling ops.track1_status() directly showed the two PowerShell spawns
measurement_that_had_to_be_redone.explanation: the endpoints were already clean because the fix was already on disk
measurement_that_had_to_be_redone.consequence: every measurement in this report carries a self-check

mode_parsing.note: shares a prefix with the safe mode and still runs every legacy entry slot; reporting it as retirement-compatible would hide legacy issues while legacy is trading

task_6_calm.already_green: the three Calm tests had cleared before this stage
properties_that_held: TRACK1_CALM_1000 is absent from the slot table and from the mirror
both current phases TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932 and TRACK1_CALM_OBSERVE_1002 are mirrored

property_that_did_not.claim: a failed Calm phase must not be recovered by Stress
property_that_did_not.why_the_green_test_missed_it: it guards the INCIDENTS lane, which keys on slot_id and was never wrong; the journal and issue lanes key on job type and every Track 1 strategy slot shares one
property_that_did_not.measured_before: TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932 failed 09:32, TRACK1_STRESS_1035 completed 10:35 -> Calm reported lifecycle_status recovered, recovered_at 10:35
property_that_did_not.family: the Stage 5ZZU defect - a bucket read as a stream - one layer up
property_that_did_not.fix: recovery keys on the SLEEVE for strategy slots via recovery_stream(), which the issue lane defers to so the two lanes cannot disagree
property_that_did_not.job_type_unchanged: everything asking 'is this a strategy slot' gets the same answer; only recovery is finer

polling.note: the baseline includes the measurement's own PowerShell; the delta is the number that matters

named_by_brief.monitor/test_schedule_status_track1_2026: pass, including the three Calm tests

stage_5zzw_tests_moved.why: they monkeypatched ops.track1_status and expected the resolver to consult it; the resolver reads the cached scan now, so they described a seam that no longer exists
stage_5zzw_tests_moved.how: each keeps its property and asserts it through _running_schedulers; the retirement fixture now writes its confirmation under tmp_path so those tests cannot be answered by the production file

remaining_failure.cause: a rule grid and a JSON.stringify in the market-view render path from Stages 5ZZL/5ZZR

safety_after.broker: the restart reconnected the read-only reader the backend always starts; no new connection from this stage's code
ops_reported_on_startup: TRACK1_ORDERS_APPROVED: removed from the child environment

still_open: ops.py itself still shells out, and should - it is a command-line tool, not a request path. What changed is that nothing on a polled path calls it, and a test makes any such call an explicit failure.

the frontend keeps its own recovery lane in realtime.js matching on job_type; it only runs to NAME the job that recovered one already marked recovered, so with the backend correct it has nothing to find - but it is a fourth lane with a coarser rule and wants its own pass
